entries.message: Skip back or forward ten seconds or drag the timeline in Picture in Picture when the video supports seeking. Thanks to Jayant Guru Shrivastava (@Jayant-Guru-Shrivastava).
WebKit can float an autoplaying preview with separate pause and audio controls, even when its player has no timeline. Thanks to Jayant Guru Shrivastava (@Jayant-Guru-Shrivastava).
